searchText: Same sentiments here. Perhaps the thinking is: "Not every staking pool will do a full consolidation, so it doesn't hurt if we have home stakers consolidating as well." Here's a document: https://notes.ethereum.org/@fradamt/maxeb-consolidation Also updated the consolidation section in this article with more details on the consolidation operation: https://ethereum2077.substack.com/p/eip-7251-increase-max-effective-balance
